data.one_liner: On-device AI for Flutter to run Gemma and other LLMs, embeddings, and speech without a server.
data.what_it_does: Provides on-device AI capabilities for Flutter apps across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux. Supports running various LLMs, vision, audio, embeddings, RAG, and speech using pluggable engines without any cloud or server requirement.
use_when: You need to run large language models or embeddings entirely on-device for privacy or offline use.
You want pluggable engines like LiteRT-LM, MediaPipe, ONNX, or llama.cpp within a Flutter application.
You require on-device RAG, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech functionality.
avoid_when: Your application relies entirely on cloud-hosted APIs and you do not need offline model execution.
Targeting platforms or architectures not supported by the required pluggable runtimes.
strengths: Supports multiple pluggable engines (LiteRT-LM, MediaPipe, ONNX, llama.cpp, OS built-in AI).
Cross-platform support spanning Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
No server or cloud dependency required for running models.
weaknesses: Requires manual platform-specific setup (such as adjusting minimum SDK versions, entitlements, or Podfiles).
Managing large model files and runtime binaries increases app complexity and package distribution size.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform configurations including minimum SDK versions on Android, Podfile static linkage and entitlements on iOS, copying helper scripts for Web, and macOS deployment target / Podfile setup.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using cloud-hosted Gemini models via Firebase rather than running models locally on the device.
